steps.what: Find and assess actual wildlife disease surveillance and population information
Assess outbreak risks and choose justified preventive programme actions
Enter and check actual preventive programme tasks and source references
outputs: checked final wildlife prevention task plan

steps.what: Commit the checked preventive programme task plan
inputs: checked final wildlife prevention task plan

steps.what: Coordinate actual preventive programs with wildlife, veterinary and land-management partners
Write and check actual programme agreements, unresolved risks and follow-up
Save the checked actual prevention coordination record

tasks.design: Configure species, location and report-date filters in the wildlife records system {OTHER} and linked task references in {PROJECT}. The biologist reads evidence, assesses risk and coordinates with partners; actual agreement and outcome records are created only after those discussions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Disease prevention can repeat report retrieval and source references in task plans.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record filters and linked task fields can reduce that repetition.
tasks.still_hard: Outbreak risk, intervention suitability and partner agreement require scientific and operational judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises uncertain surveillance and adjusts the programme with actual partners.
tasks.altitude: Less report finding; programme and disease-response authority stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native wildlife-record filters and linked task fields can support disease-programme preparation; they do not predict outbreaks or obtain partner agreement.

assumptions: Boundary is actual programme coordination and existing plan/agreement records. Veterinary decisions, field interventions and partner labour belong to actual owners with no avoided labour claimed.

Surveillance producers supply actual species, location, observation date, finding and source version. Biologist checks applicability and missing reports in s1, chooses actions in s2 and captures actual agreements after s5. Missing source fields stay manual; no outbreak status or partner acceptance is generated from a task plan.

Test native filters and linked task references before code. Existing record views earn no saving. Reading stays in s1 and actual risk judgement and agreements remain fully retained; s3 reduction only concerns repeated references and context.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Each commit/save is one percent fully retained and uses the existing plan or record check.
unknowns: Which surveillance sources are already searchable?
What actual plan and agreement records are maintained?
research_questions: Can native retrieval reduce preparation without treating incomplete surveillance as a confirmed disease picture?

incremental.description: Maintain surveillance filters and programme-reference fields.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final wildlife prevention task plan and exact project destination; edits require recheck
s6 checked final actual prevention coordination record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 20*0.30 source finding + 14*0.20 repeated task fields = 8.8; minus 0.8 upkeep = 8. With half the retrieval and fields eligible, 4.4 minus 0.8 = 3.6. Risk assessment and partner coordination remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check environmental compliance and notify law enforcement of actual violations.

steps.what: Find and read actual applicable environmental laws and site permit conditions
inputs: actual applicable laws and permit versions

steps.what: Inspect actual wildlife activity and collect environmental compliance evidence
Check compliance, resolve actual noncompliance and decide whether a violation requires notification
outputs: actual compliance finding and notification decision

steps.what: Write the actual violation notice and evidence references for law enforcement
inputs: actual compliance finding and notification decision

loop.purpose: Draft factual notice from the biologist's actual violation finding
loop.input: Actual chosen finding, verified requirement references and observed evidence
loop.check: Biologist checks allegations, uncertainty, omitted contrary evidence, legal meaning and source accuracy against actual finding and observations
loop.stop: No actual reportable finding or two failed revisions returns notice writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Use authority-required fields first; factual explanations vary across actual violations

steps.what: Check the final notice, actual evidence and competent law-enforcement destination
Notify law enforcement by submitting the checked final violation notice

tasks.design: Configure actual requirement-reference search in {DOCS}, then use authority-required fields before a bounded draft of a factual notice. The biologist inspects, judges compliance and resolves or escalates actual findings; the final notice is checked before its separate submission to {GOV_PORTAL}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Requirement finding and factual notification prose can be repeated across compliance cases.
tasks.enabler_now: Native search and bounded drafting can reduce retrieval and first-draft writing without deciding legality.
tasks.still_hard: Applicability, evidence sufficiency, remediation and reporting duties require human judgement and actual authority.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist distinguishes an observed problem from a justified legal allegation.
tasks.altitude: Less reference and notice preparation; compliance and reporting responsibility stay unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-reference search and bounded factual drafting can support compliance records; they cannot determine environmental legality or the competent authority.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual compliance checks, remediation decisions and notices only where a real finding requires them. Reweight no-violation cases rather than generating a notice. Actual physical remediation by an operator and enforcement decisions are not saved biologist labour.

Requirement owner or authority supplies actual rule/permit identifier, applicability and version; biologist reads them in s1 and captures actual observations in s2. Actual owner responses inform s3. Missing evidence stays manual; the draft uses only the biologist's actual finding and never invents a violation.

Test native search and authority fields before code. Existing lookup earns no saving. Reading, inspection and legal judgement stay human; final submission occurs only with the biologist's actual reporting authority and verified destination.
Shares are provisional, not measured baselines. Routine submission retains one percent; the final notice check is existing correspondence work.
unknowns: Which national rules, permits and authority destinations apply?
What notification authority does the biologist actually hold?
research_questions: Does drafting save time after checking every allegation and contrary observation?

already_counted.description: Correct factual and legal meaning in notice draft within s4.

incremental.description: Maintain source filters and factual-notice drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final environmental violation notice, exact evidence and competent authority destination; edits void approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 15*0.40 retrieval + 14*0.30 notice prose = 10.2; subtract 1 upkeep = 9.2. If half the retrieval and prose qualify, 5.1 minus 1 = 4.1. Compliance judgement and actual submission are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Handle zoo fundraising, public relations, budgets and staff supervision.

steps.what: Verify actual zoo fundraising, public relations, budget and staffing context
Write actual fundraising correspondence for the zoo programme

loop.input: Verified zoo facts and human-chosen fundraising purpose and terms
loop.check: Biologist checks factual meaning, unsupported impact promises, omitted restrictions and consistency with actual fundraising terms
loop.stop: Missing purpose or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Use existing fundraising fields first; actual appeal explanations vary

steps.what: Check final fundraising correspondence, terms and actual recipient
Send the checked fundraising correspondence to the actual recipient
Write actual public relations content about the zoo's scientific work

loop.purpose: Draft actual zoo public relations content
loop.input: Verified public facts and actual audience purpose
loop.check: Biologist checks scientific meaning, omitted uncertainty, unsupported animal-welfare claims and disclosure scope
loop.stop: Missing approved facts or two failed revisions returns writing to manual work
loop.why_not_simpler: Reuse existing public-content fields first; explanations vary with actual zoo work

steps.what: Check the final public relations content and actual publication destination
outputs: checked final zoo public relations content

steps.what: Publish the checked zoo public relations content to its authorised destination
inputs: checked final zoo public relations content

steps.what: Prepare and check the actual zoo budget and chosen allocation assumptions
Save the checked actual zoo budget revision
Supervise actual zoo staff, discuss work and resolve operational issues
Write and check actual zoo staff decisions and follow-up records
Save the checked actual zoo supervision record

tasks.design: Use native budget links from {ERP} into {SPREADSHEET} and fixed communication fields before bounded drafts of actual fundraising and public content. The biologist checks each exact final communication before its separate send or publication, chooses budget allocations and retains staff supervision and its actual records.
tasks.previous_blocker: Broad zoo administration can repeat first-draft correspondence and budget figure entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native financial links and bounded communication drafts can reduce repetitive preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Fundraising commitments, disclosure, budget priorities and staff judgement require actual authority and relationships.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist weighs scientific and animal-care priorities and handles real donor and staff concerns.
tasks.altitude: Less first-draft prose and budget entry; spending and public-communication authority stay as delegated.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked budget tables and bounded source-linked writing can support zoo administration; they do not choose spending priorities or authorise commitments.

assumptions: The statement names several alternative administrative duties. Shares are a provisional mix, not a daily sequence: reweight to actual fundraising, public relations, budget and supervision work rather than adding any absent duty.

This communication branch assumes the biologist actually has authority to send the fundraising text and publish the public content; otherwise use the real release owner with their labour outside the focal denominator and no transferred savings. Actual budgets are saved drafts, not spending commitments.

Finance records supply actual account, period, cost centre, amount and currency; biologist verifies these and approved public facts in s1. Donor purpose, terms, audience and spending choices are supplied by the actual biologist in s2-s8. Missing fields are entered manually; budget allocation judgement and generated meaning correction remain in retained time.
Test native templates and budget links before code. Existing links earn no saving. Actual supervision outcomes are captured only after s10; no free transcript or staff agreement is assumed.

Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. Every routine send, publication and save has one percent fully retained time; existing content, budget and record checks provide exact-version gates.
unknowns: What administrative duties does the biologist actually perform?
Who holds publication and fundraising authority?
Are actual budget figures already linked?
research_questions: Does assisted prose and native budget reuse save effort after actual source verification, corrections and allocation judgement?

already_counted.description: Correct fundraising and public-content meaning within s2 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain budget links and communication drafting checks.

approvals.approved_version: s3 checked final fundraising correspondence, exact terms and donor recipient; changes void approval
s6 checked final zoo public content and exact authorised publication destination; edits void approval
s8 checked final zoo budget revision and exact workbook destination; edits require recheck
s11 checked final actual zoo supervision record and exact project destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 14*0.30 fundraising prose + 14*0.30 public prose + 20*0.40 budget entry = 16.4; minus 2 upkeep = 14.4. If half that prose and budget entry are eligible, 8.2 minus 2 = 6.2. Supervision, decisions and all sends/saves stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Identify and classify animals from their characteristics.

steps.what: Observe and measure actual animal characteristics and record field context
Enter and check actual animal measurements in the specimen records system {OTHER}
Compare animal characteristics with actual taxonomic keys and reference specimens
Identify and classify the animal and assess unresolved taxonomic uncertainty
outputs: chosen actual animal identification and uncertainty

steps.what: Write and check actual animal classification and supporting evidence references
inputs: chosen actual animal identification and uncertainty

steps.what: Save the checked actual animal classification record

tasks.design: Configure native specimen identifier and instrument-file fields in the specimen records system {OTHER}. The biologist still observes morphology, captures actual measurements, checks their mapping, uses taxonomic references and decides the classification; only repeated identifier and numerical entry change.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual specimen measurements and identifiers can be typed again after field or instrument capture.
tasks.enabler_now: Native specimen links and supported measurement imports can reduce that repeated entry.
tasks.still_hard: Variable morphology, cryptic species and incomplete specimens require taxonomic expertise.
tasks.human_edge: The biologist recognises when the available traits cannot justify a species-level identification.
tasks.altitude: Less specimen data repetition; identification authority stays unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: specimen systems can reuse identifiers and supported instrument measurements; this does not perform animal identification or taxonomic judgement.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual characteristic analysis and its existing classification record. No automatic image identification or species claim is introduced.

The biologist captures actual specimen identifier, location, date and morphological observations in s1; supported instruments supply actual numerical value and unit there. Biologist checks and manually completes mapping in s2. Unsupported measurements and all descriptive observations stay manual; no free structured morphology is assumed.

Test native identifier links and imports before code. Existing automated capture earns no saving. Native taxonomic search and fixed record fields are considered, but this scenario retains reference comparison and final classification writing because their changed effort is unproven.
Shares and reductions are provisional, not measured baselines. Final save retains one percent and uses the existing classification-record check.
unknowns: Which measurements and identifiers are typed twice?
What record features and taxonomic references are already linked?
research_questions: Can actual specimen measurements be reused without losing identifier or morphological context?

incremental.description: Maintain specimen identifier and measurement-field configuration.

approvals.approved_version: s5 checked final animal classification record and exact specimen destination; edits require recheck

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Gross 10*0.50 repeated identifier and numerical entry = 5; minus 0.5 upkeep = 4.5. If half those fields can be reused, 2.5 minus 0.5 = 2. Observation, taxonomy and record judgement stay unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Wildlife science, compliance decisions and staff judgement stay with the biologist while repeated reference handling and actual document drafts can shrink.
role.ambitious_version: Formal authority stays unchanged; validate reduced preparation on actual wildlife science and administration work.
